composition.raw_value: 135 mL deionized water in the flask; 3-butyn-1-ol diluted with a separate 135 mL chilled deionized water

operation.raw_value: Charge water, 70% nitric acid, sodium dichromate dihydrate and sodium periodate; stir vigorously on an ice bath.

operation.raw_value: Add the chilled 3-butyn-1-ol solution slowly to the oxidant mixture.

operation.raw_value: Filter the reaction mixture to remove insoluble salts.
operation.normalized_value: Filter the reaction mixture to remove insoluble salts.

operation.raw_value: Extract the product from the aqueous phase with diethyl ether five times (80 mL each).

operation.raw_value: Combine the organic fractions, dry over anhydrous magnesium sulfate and concentrate by rotary evaporation to an orange viscous liquid.

operation.raw_value: Wash with pentane three times (200 mL each) and concentrate again by rotary evaporation to obtain an off-white solid.
